study.question: Observed limitation: the earlier broad reductions lost click AUC: embedding12=0.6641111849, scorer half=0.6654368616, both=0.6657555717 (g2-r0024-joint_embedding12, g2-r0024-joint_scorer_half, g2-r0024-joint_embedding12_scorer_half); tower half=0.6654569217 and combined readout half=0.6652781389 (g2-r0025-joint_tower_half, g2-r0025-joint_readout_half). Residual8 alone reached0.6665364798 but had no observed latency reduction (g2-r0025-joint_residual_half, p50=23.546ms versus23.436ms control). Round26 width12 gave0.6669370377 versus0.6667535475 at width16. Indexed adapter evaluation preserved each width's AUC exactly: width12 train318.906s/p50=22.377ms versus341.019s/23.709ms for full-bank execution; width16 indexed train322.743s/p50=22.505ms versus333.193s/23.687ms full bank. Width12 indexed has319333 dense/32112549 total parameters. These are one-seed observations; total inference timing was mixed across pairs. Source inspection now shows _joint_coefficients computes ordered/scrambled/joint-support alternatives whose outputs cannot reach its frozen available/norm return. Can removing this dead arithmetic reduce cost without changing behavior, and can residual width10 additionally preserve click AUC?
study.hypothesis: H1, execution: specializing the constructor-enforced available/norm coefficient branch retains the exact live expression and removes only pure computations with no live data dependency, buffers, parameter access or RNG. At fixed width/state its coefficients, all predictions, parameter/input gradients and optimizer updates should therefore match. It may reduce kernel launch and arithmetic cost. H2, capacity: width12's success and width8's smaller AUC loss justify one intermediate width10 test while keeping embedding/scorer/tower capacity fixed. Width10 may preserve quality at lower parameter count; latency benefit is unverified. Removing dead arithmetic is an engineering contribution; width reduction is tuning. Neither constitutes a new unified-modeling mechanism or establishes optimal allocation. Prospective screening rule for these unrun variants: click AUC loss at most0.0005 absolute (0.05 percentage points) versus BOTH the contemporaneous width12 indexed control and frozen entry g0-r0022-support_rotated_attached (AUC0.666753547526167). The latter floor is0.666253547526167; the historical width12 comparator implies0.666437037651279, but the actual paired reference determines its floor. This engineering tolerance is not a confidence interval or a claim of statistical noninferiority. No accessible prior proposal records a numeric margin; this rule is frozen only for the upcoming comparisons and does not retrospectively reclassify old trials. Any superseding host-frozen stricter criterion takes precedence. Efficiency screening requires at least3% lower matched model-only batch p50 latency, p95 no more than2% worse, and total validation inference seconds and training wall seconds each no more than2% worse, against the contemporaneous width12 indexed reference. Count parameters and peak memory separately. A cost claim remains provisional until repeated interleaved host measurements support it; loading-inclusive inference time is not model-only latency. The width10 versus width12 contrast is also reported within each execution mode, even if it fails selection. A fast specialized width12 result supports removable computation, not removable learned capacity.

study.proposed_difference: A2x2 replacement factorial: residual_hidden in{12,10} crossed with inherited versus specialized _joint_coefficients. Every cell inherits indexed adapter execution. Specialized cells retain, in the same AST expression and order, position_norm2, match_norm2, available and available_norm, then return available_norm directly. The existing constructor already rejects other match-support/scaling configurations. Remove unused joint projection/gating alternatives only; _coarse_extension_coefficients and all other methods are unchanged at a fixed width. All four modules are standalone. Analytical parameter expectations: width12 dense319333/total32112549; width10 dense310725/total32103941 (8608 fewer;0.0268% of total,2.70% of dense). Specialization changes no parameter count. Host measurement must verify these predictions.
predictions: Within each width pair, loading identical state should give identical five summary tensors, predictions in train/eval, Dice buffer updates, parameter and input gradients, and one frozen-optimizer step. Specialization consumes no extra RNG. Treat unexpected BF16 differences as a failed equivalence check before interpreting training.

Across widths12/10, preserve the predeclared AUC tolerance above and reduce dense parameters by8608. All four task AUC/Logloss values, auxiliary mean separately and existing history-length slices with counts must be reported; no auxiliary quality preservation is assumed.

If dead joint-coefficient work materially contributes to measured prediction cost, specialized versus inherited source lowers model-only p50 at both widths with no cost interaction that reverses the effect. The2x2 identifies width, execution and their interaction; it does not identify unseen representation reallocations.

If only specialization succeeds, retain width12 and report a function-preserving execution improvement. If width10 also passes quality/cost gates and repeated host validation, it becomes a provisional smaller candidate. Choose by validation only; never use held-out outcomes in this decision.
falsifiers: Any fixed-state equal-width summary/output/buffer/gradient/optimizer discrepancy or added masked/forbidden-input sensitivity rejects the function-preservation implementation. Record the failure and its cost; do not attribute it to the broader idea without a discriminating correction.

Click AUC loss beyond either predeclared comparator margin rejects width10 utility under this recipe, even if auxiliary mean rises. A reproducible loss narrows the tested residual-width interval and does not prove all remaining capacity necessary.

No measured cost reduction meeting the frozen screen, or a training/total-inference/p95 regression beyond the guardrail, rejects efficiency utility for that cell; fewer source operations or parameters alone are insufficient.

Unstable timing gains across matched remeasurements, or quality differences across equal-width full/specialized training, leave the claimed effect unsupported until resolved. No new mechanism or priority claim is made.
alternative_explanations: The frozen single seed does not estimate initialization uncertainty; repeated identical-seed bridges estimate runtime variability only.
Width changes the residual initialization shapes and optimization trajectory; it is not a capacity-matched reallocation or proof of a new representation.
GPU scheduling, memory allocation, warmup and data loading can affect timing. Static operation removal does not guarantee wall-clock benefit.
No user-cluster bootstrap or individual predictions are available in this proposal workspace; no significance or population equivalence claim is admissible.
All prior reduction results are bounded implementations. Negative embedding/scorer/tower trajectories do not refute heterogeneous field allocation or all smaller models.

The previous external cards were considered but round26 executed only residual-width/indexed-execution changes. Its positive outcomes do not validate UniMixer, MixFormer, Zenith or EST. Other external architectures may offer larger gains, but no such transfer is tested here.

The published offline history visibility and whole-window vocab/static-snapshot assumptions remain inherited limitations; auxiliary labels are category/brand-matched24h outcomes, not ad-specific conversion attribution. Preserve these caveats across all cells.
